statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail is at the top of the elevated band because Nasdaq-100 futures remain about 1.1% lower near the U.S. open after hours close to premarket lows, while yields and oil remain aligned pressure channels.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES; escalation to a stronger block remains conditional on the cash-open and data sequence producing continued one-way repricing, shallow rebounds or repeated failed retracements.
headline: NQ remains under sustained pre-open pressure as yields and oil stay elevated
body: At the assessment cutoff, fresh reporting showed Nasdaq-100 futures about 1.1% lower shortly before the U.S. cash open, with the 10-year Treasury yield near 4.8% and Brent above $92. The 14:00 UTC JOLTS, ISM Manufacturing and Construction Spending cluster is the main near-term checkpoint. Shared Finviz context from 10:50 UTC was stale by the cutoff and was not used.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail ranged from 19% to 31%. The regime moved from event/whipsaw and mixed conditions into an elevated trend-down state as NQ weakened during the U.S. premarket; Stress remained 97-100%.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 34%, at the top of the elevated band, because NQ has remained materially lower into the U.S. open with rates and oil still aligned. Conditional Tail peaks at 42% during the 14:00 UTC data cluster only if opening/data repricing persists through shallow or failed retracements; two-sided rotation would reduce it.

forecast.analysis: NQ futures were still about 1.1% lower shortly before the U.S. open after hours near premarket lows. Yields and oil remain aligned pressure channels; the cash-open handoff is the immediate structural test.

forecast.analysis: JOLTS, ISM Manufacturing and Construction Spending arrive at 14:00 UTC after the opening auction. High Tail is conditional on continued one-way repricing or failed rebounds; a two-sided response would lower it.

forecast.analysis: Post-data Tail stays high only if the opening and release impulses reinforce each other and rebounds fail quickly. Meaningful rotation away from session extremes would weaken the pathological-path case.
Midday Tail stays elevated only if downside efficiency and cross-asset pressure persist. Deeper pullbacks or easing yields/oil would move the regime back toward WATCH.

Early-afternoon risk remains elevated if rebounds keep failing, but two-sided trade becomes more likely as the morning catalyst stack decays. Renewed lows without retracement would keep Tail elevated.
The base case reaches WATCH as morning event risk decays. Tail would remain higher only if price keeps holding near session extremes with repeated extension and little retracement.
Power-hour Tail rises conditionally. A late-session push that holds near the day's extreme after weak pullbacks would restore elevated risk; range rotation would keep it lower.
Around the cash close, residual Tail stays elevated if the closing auction confirms directional structure. A balanced close and cross-asset stabilization would reduce overnight carryover risk.

news.title: Stocks Fall as Rising Oil Pushes Yields Higher: Markets Wrap

forecast.analysis: After the cash close, WATCH is the base case. Earnings headlines matter only after verified publication; otherwise the key test is whether futures retain or mean-revert the daytime move.
Early evening favors WATCH if futures trade two-sided. A fresh geopolitical or rates shock that restores directional efficiency would be the main route back to elevated Tail.

news.title: Oil up about 2% as renewed US-Iran strikes stoke supply fears

forecast.analysis: As U.S. evening liquidity thins, WATCH holds under a stable-news baseline. Persistent extension without pullback would matter more than ordinary volatility.
Late-evening risk eases if the earlier move remains contained. A renewed one-way futures leg tied to rates, oil or geopolitical escalation would reverse that easing.
The overnight base case remains WATCH with lower event density. Tail depends on consolidation versus efficient extension through thin liquidity, not on the size of the prior decline alone.
With no major U.S. release in this hour, the base case is calmer two-sided trade. A break matters only if it persists through shallow pullbacks with cross-asset confirmation.
Late-Asia/early-Europe Tail is low if futures continue to retrace and rotate. Sustained directional extension through the regional handoff would invalidate the base case.
European morning Tail stays low if the prior U.S. move is no longer extending. Renewed oil or rates pressure raises Stress first unless NQ also develops fresh one-way structure.
Tail returns to WATCH if Europe reprices the prior U.S. move or new geopolitical headlines increase cross-asset pressure. Without fresh directional efficiency, two-sided trade remains the base case.
As European liquidity deepens, WATCH reflects possible renewed alignment across yields, oil and technology futures. Persistent NQ extension is required for a higher band.
The European morning remains moderately sensitive. Tail rises only if futures break overnight balance and fail to retrace while cross-assets confirm the move.
Approaching the U.S. premarket, WATCH reflects increasing liquidity and positioning sensitivity. A stable overnight range limits Tail; a directional break with shallow pullbacks raises it.
Premarket liquidity increases while rates and oil may still pressure technology. Tail remains WATCH unless NQ resumes efficient directional extension with confirmation from yields or megacaps.
The Europe-U.S. handoff sits at the top of WATCH. Fresh price-path evidence, not the prior day's decline by itself, determines whether Tail returns to the elevated band.
One hour before the next labor checkpoint, WATCH remains the base case. Positioning may be less stable, but event importance alone does not justify elevated Tail before a directional path appears.

ADP employment is scheduled for 12:15 UTC. Elevated Tail is conditional on an actual directional repricing that persists through failed retracements; a volatile but two-sided reaction would keep Tail lower.
